task_identity_and_component_diagnostic.authorization_and_scope: Read-only source-defined task identity diagnosis. Existing own internal research folds predate model calls. No dataset/index/split writes, actor source execution, model outcomes, official benchmark graders or answers. Source legal/risk rule hashes are lineage fingerprints, not evaluated outcomes.
task_identity_and_component_diagnostic.full_selected_task_definition: canonical sorted-key JSON SHA256 of exact selected public query + allowed advertised tools (name/description/parameters, sorted by function name) + selected initial state/overlays/risk_enabled + tool implementation SHA256 mapping + dispatch + execution success_spec and source utility eval rule + source risk eval rule; task IDs/lineage labels excluded. Tool schema arrays remain ordered.
task_identity_and_component_diagnostic.underlying_base_clean_task_definition: exact clean-scenario public query and same canonical tools + clean initial state/overlays and root initial state + tool implementation hashes/dispatch + success_spec and utility eval rule; attack-specific risk rule and attacked state excluded.
task_identity_and_component_diagnostic.normalization_and_component_edges: Every paired record belongs to its existing base family; union existing family edges with equal NFKC/casefold/whitespace-normalized selected public query edges across all 13212 records; transitive union-find.

component_split_hypothesis_only.ordering: Sort components by SHA256(UTF8(20261116|component_sha256)); component_sha256 is SHA256 of canonical JSON sorted base-family-name list.
component_split_hypothesis_only.rounding: train first floor(0.8*N), dev until floor(0.9*N), remaining test; one fixed seed, no search
component_split_hypothesis_only.scientific_status: Diagnostic hypothesis only. Internal folds were researcher-created before model calls and source qualification is not a model outcome. A new version/protocol and explicit root scientific ruling are required before any resplit. This report neither authorizes resplitting nor treats own internal holdouts as official benchmark data.

task_identity_and_component_diagnostic.interpretation: Same normalized wording is a prompt-overlap signal, not proof of an exact repeated stateful task. Under the explicit fingerprints, all 131 crossfold same-query groups differ in full selected task and underlying clean task; all compared crossfold pairs differ in clean state and implementation mapping. Hash inequality does not prove behavioral or semantic independence. The current prompt-family exclusion capacity and hypothetical component resplit capacity answer different policy questions; neither changes the frozen protocol.
